left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  American Indian youth aged 13-24 years old who are San Felipe tribal members living in the Pueblo
  -  Endorse suicidal ideation  [OR] or behaviors on a universal screen by their primary care provider

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Younger than age  [OR] of 13 years old or
  -  Older than the age of 24,
  -  Not American Indian,
  -  Youth  [AND] who do not receive health services at either of the IHS clinics at the Pueblo of San Felipe,
  -  Youth  [AND] who screen negative for suicidal ideation  [OR] and/or behavior,
  -  Refuse to participate in the study, and/or
  -  Cognitively unable to provide informed consent as demonstrated by a brief cognitive screen prior to completion of the baseline interview
